name: Silver Shields
source:
You play as the newest recruit in an adventuring guild called the Silver Shields after responding to a flyer. You’ll meet and befriend your fellow guildmates—and even might find love! The story is focused on all the day to day elements of a life lived in the guild, and downtime and travel between adventures. 

[From [url=https://greyenwright.itch.io/silver-shields]itch.io[/url]]
